buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 8. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document

in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Preference shall be given to local bidder i.e. Consignee’s city with work experience of three years with the Government organization. 2.Certified copy of the PAN Card should be attached. 3.The vendor should be registered with GST. Certified copy of the registration should be attached with the Bid document. 4.The interested parties must be capable of providing vehicles on their own on the following terms and con ditions : (i) That the vehicle shall be kept neat and clean and in perfect running condition provided with seat belts, seat covers and curtains, (ii) That the minimum running of vehicle shall be 2500 KMs per month and up to this running, no additiona l charges shall be paid, (iii) That payment, subject to Tax Deduction at Source (TDS)/(GST), shall be made on monthly basis on pro duction of bills for the respective months, (iv) That the vehicles should be provided along with driver who possesses valid driving license and integrit y of the drivers should be beyond doubt, (v) That driver provided with the vehicle must follow traffic rules and other regulations prescribed by the G overnment from time to time, (vi) In the case of any accident, all the claims arising out of it shall be met by the contractor/Service Provid er, (vii) If the vehicle goes out of order, the contractor shall provide a substitute vehicle immediately. In case, vehicle does not report on time or does not report at all, the department would have a Right to hire a vehic le from the market and the additional cost incurred by the Department will be borne by the contractor, (viii) The contract between the Department and the vendor can be cancelled with prior notice of at least 3 0 days by the operator, (ix) The driver must observe all the etiquette and protocol while performing duty. He must be neatly dress ed, should wear proper uniform and must carry a mobile phone in working condition, for which no separate payment shall be made by the department, (x) The vendor and driver shall be bound to carry out the instructions of the department as well as of the of ficers assigned to the vehicle, (xi) A daily record indicating time and mileage for each vehicle shall be maintained by the driver in a log-b ook and countersigned by the controlling officer on the basis of which monthly bill shall be raised by the v endor, (xii) The vehicle shall be at the disposal of Income Tax Department for 7 days a week and in weekends wh en not in use shall be parked at Income Tax Office premises or at the residence of the Officer to whom the vehicle is assigned, (xiii) That all the expenses incurred for maintaining and running of the vehicle including driver's salary, leg al expenses/taxes (Except GST), fuel, lubes, spares, repairs, vehicle maintenance, shall be sole responsibili ty of the vendor, who will ensure that the vehicle is always kept in good condition. There shall be no lack o

f periodical service of vehicle and vehicle shall be always be kept in ready condition to run on road physic ally and legally, (xiv) That all the due taxes, payments and compliances shall be made regularly and within time for continu ed registration of the vehicle with the Road Tax Authorities, Payment of Road Tax, Insurance, Pollution und er Control Certificate etc. and copies of relevant documents including insurance, PUC etc shall be filed regu larly with the department, (xv) That settlement of excess and less running shall be made on a six monthly basis meaning thereby tha t running less than 2500 KMs per month shall be accumulated till 6 months and running more than 2500 K Ms in subsequent or earlier month shall also be accumulated till 6 months and the running of 15000 KMs. Every six months on a rolling basis shall be treated within package payment and any excess of this runnin g shall be paid @ Rs. 12 per Kilometer, (xvi) No extra payment shall be made for increase in running cost of vehicle like increase in rates of fuel, l ubes, salary of driver, insurance, taxes etc, (xvii) In the event of the award of the tender and prior to execution of the contract, the Contractor shall be required to submit copies of the Registrations Certificate, and Comprehensive insurance policies of the veh icle being offered for hire and particulars with photograph of the driver, (xviii) The vendor must also ensure that all the necessary documents (Registration Certificate, Insurance p apers, PUC Certificate etc.) are available with the driver deployed for duty for the Department, (xix) Once the hiring of the vehicle commences from a particular bidder, the vehicles and the driver should not be changed unless so requested for by the controlling Officers, (xx) Vehicle sought Toyota Hycross/ Toyota Innova Crysta/ Toyota Fortuner will only accepted. No lower ca tegory vehicle will be accepted by the Department during the entire Contract, (xxi) The vendor submitting the tender would be presumed to have read and fully understood all the terms and conditions and instructions contained in the tender documents and parts/ annexure thereof. No inquiry , verbal or written, shall be entertained in respect of acceptance/rejection of the Bid, (xxii) During the period of contract, the Department can reduce any number of vehicles hired by issuing a notice to the Vendor, if required to do so as per requirement of the department and remaining vehicles will be continued as per final rates arising out of this Bid on GeM and all other terms and conditions of this Bid on GeM will continue, (xxiii) In case of breach of any of terms and conditions mentioned above, the competent Authority will hav e the right to cancel the work order/ contract without assigning any reason thereof and nothing will be pay able by the Department, (xxiv) For all disputes/ differences/ interpretations etc. whatsoever arising out of or relating to this contrac t, meaning and operation or effect of breach of this contract, the decision of the Principal Commissioner of I ncome Tax-1, Agra shall be final. 5. Registration of vehicle should be in the name of of firm/company/vendor. .
